coverage.main: Read all thirteen pages of arXiv 2103.10609v1 (19 March 2021; BMVC 2021): Sections 1-5, Algorithm, Tables 1-5, Figures 1-6, references and the appended supplementary material (Tables 6-7 for Inc-v4, IncRes-v2 and Res-101 sources). The BMVC version of record was not retrieved.
coverage.supplement: The supplementary material is appended to the arXiv PDF and read.
coverage.excluded_results: White-box (starred source) cells of Tables 1-7; Figures 1-2 are illustrations.

result_groups.population: 1,000 randomly chosen ILSVRC 2012 validation images; single sources (Inc-v3, Inc-v4, IncRes-v2, Res-101) and a four-model ensemble; four normally trained and three ensemble-adversarially trained targets
result_groups.outcome: attack success rate: 'the misclassification rates of the corresponding models using adversarial examples as the inputs'
result_groups.evidence: No clean-correct filter is stated, and the rate definition is the bare outcome wording coded unclear for ranks 5 and 21.

result_groups.population: Same images; ensemble source; HGD, R&P, NIPS-r3, RS, ARS, FD, Bit-Red

f2.evidence: No clean-correct restriction or explicit inclusion statement.

f3.evidence: No source-success rule; bare outcome definition.

f4.evidence: One-decimal rates without a stated denominator.

f5.evidence: Maximum perturbation epsilon = 16/255 on [0, 1] pixels, T = 10.

f6.evidence: No code link in the paper.

artifact_checks.result: Downloaded and hashed; the only repository linked is the NIPS-r3 defense; no author attack code is linked.

bounds_checks.reason: No clean accuracy on the 1,000 images is reported.

limitations: Non-blind evidence audit; coded consistently with ranks 5 and 21 for the bare misclassification-rate wording.
